input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering or selling Inventory via other agents or third parties, so we retain full freedom to use alternative suppliers/channels. The only other "exclusive" references are unrelated and non-restrictive: the license to Customer is non-exclusive (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction/venue (p0064), each Party's ownership of its own marks (p0065), the entire-agreement wording (p0072), and no-third-party-beneficiary language (p0073). No sole-supplier, all-requirements, or no-third-party-procurement obligation binds Customer anywhere in the document. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer); no redline required.
